description: This file defines the CodebaseSearchTool class, which provides functionality for searching codebases using managed indexing or fallback to external code index management. It includes methods for parsing parameters, executing searches, handling partial requests, and integrating with external services like VSCode workspace and code index managers.

classes.name: CodebaseSearchTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool to perform codebase searches, utilizing managed indexer or external code index services, with support for progress status and user approval.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters to extract query and path, normalizing the path.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the codebase search, handling user approval, index status checks, and formatting search results.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial tool requests by prompting for missing parameters.
